name: Ruijie Networks Co., Ltd.
summary: Ruijie Networks Co., Ltd. is a Chinese company that specializes in the global research, development, production, and marketing of a diverse range of networking and IT solutions. Its comprehensive portfolio includes various types of switches (such as data center, core/aggregation, industrial, and access models), an array of wireless products like indoor, wall-mount, and outdoor access points, along with their controllers and accessories. The company also delivers advanced cloud-managed security and integrated gateway solutions, alongside extensive software for cloud, security, and network management, as well as a selection of aggregation and access routers. Beyond hardware, Ruijie extends its offerings to include cloud services and specialized IT management, authentication, and accounting services. Ruijie caters to a broad spectrum of industries, serving sectors such as energy, government, hospitality, telecommunications, healthcare, transportation, finance, and education, among others. Established in Fuzhou, China, in 2000, Ruijie Networks operates as a subsidiary of Fujian Star-net Communication Co., LTD.
